Name: Tiny Nooks Farmhouse
Author: Sharogg
Description:
I wanted to see how small I could make the farmhouse while keeping all the renovation options and it still making sense, so this is what I came up with.

You may think the fully renovated farmhouse is not really tiny any more, and maybe it isn't but it's still smaller in terms of usable floor tiles than the unrenovated vanilla farmhouse at the last upgrade level, and unrenovated Tiny nooks 2nd upgrade is smaller then the vanilla farmhouse with the 1st upgrade.

So you can have it pretty tiny or more reasonably sized depending on how many renovations you choose to get. Even the smallest version offers a bit of space to decorate and space for spouse and kids.

[b]Make sure you read the description carefully before you report a bug/ask about compatibility/etc![/b]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Tiny to compact design depending on how many renovations you choose to get.[/*]
[*]All wall tiles decoratable.[/*]
[*]One continuous floor - spouse/kids/pets can access the whole house.[/*]
[*]Kitchen options: minimal, full, or no kitchen for use with modular kitchen mods.[/*]
[*]Optional starter kitchen.[/*]
[*]Optional starter furniture (requires MMAP) - Furniture made to fit the small space of the starter farmhouse, this will override all the custom furniture from whichever farm map you are using except for wallpapers and floors.[/*]
[*]Full renovation support (renamed and customized).[/*]
[*]Each farmhouse upgrade level is toggleable separately in case you want to use cabins as shed or another farmhouse mod for a different upgrade (as long as you can disable the other upgrades in that mod as well.[/*]
[*]Automatic furniture relocation on upgrade with MMAP.[/*]
[/list]
I chose not to include any separate rooms as greenhouse/attic as some other farmhouse mods do, If you want these types of extra rooms check out my PIF rooms: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36797]Attics[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43657]Sunrooms[/url], and more.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528472.png[/img]

[list]
[*]If you have furniture relocation with MMAP turned on, you won't get the upgraded double bed or child beds. This will hopefully be fixed soon by MMAP. You can also disable it and the furniture shouldn't be too bad as I started designing this before the MMAP solution. Noclip mode may be needed in some cases though.[/*]
[*]If you marry Emily, her parrot will not be in the correct space in her spouse room.[/*]
[*]There is a hardcoded tile on the right side of the map which can be fixed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿. This should also fix some other issues like spouse rooms or cellar stairs disappearing.[/*]
[*]Farmhouse mods are known to be a bit buggy so there might be more problems. Feel free to let me know so I can add to the list but it's not guaranteed that I can do anything about it.[/*]
[*]May not work correctly with custom spouses and/or events that take place in the farmhouse[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img]
﻿
[b]Compatible[/b]
[list]
[*]Recolours: Check my tilesheet mod for supported recolours (currently VPR and Earthy for full compatibility, as well as darker vanilla options for wainscoting and room borders, but you can choose individually for use with another recolour without any hard clashes as I didn't mix similar vanilla and custom tiles (like the room borders).[/*]
[*]Spouse room free decoration[/*]
[/list]
[b]Partially compatible[/b]
[list]
[*]Other mods that change the farmhouse: not inherently incompatible, as you can switch off and on each farmhouse upgrade separately and turn off the mod completely, but you can always only use one at a time for each upgrade, and if you can't toggle individually there may be conflicts.[/*]
[*]Custom cellars: Compatiblity not guaranteed if the entrance location is changed in the cellar map.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Incompatible/not tested[/b]
[list]
[*]Polyamory sweet and similar mods: No compat guaranteed and I probably won't be able to implement a fix if there are issues[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528309.png[/img]

Inspired by most of the other farmhouse mods that are around. Special thanks to mushimato for making farmhouses better with MMAP.
